card.name: US state codes and ZIP codes in addresses
card.fires_on: Two-letter US state abbreviations after a city and comma, and the digits of the ZIP code that follow, in organization mailing addresses.

modes.label: State abbreviation
modes.description: The two-letter state code right after the city name in a street or PO box address.
modes.example: Contact: Barry Tonning, Environmental Policy Analyst, The Council of State Governments, P.O. Box 11910, Lexington,<< KY>> 4057819

modes.label: ZIP code digits
modes.description: A digit inside or at the end of a five-digit ZIP code following the state.
modes.example: acydirectory.org American Federation for the Blind 11 Penn Plaza, Suite 300 New York, NY 1000<<1>> Toll-free telephone:

card.plain: It lights up on the state abbreviation and ZIP code in a US mailing address.
